svg.text: Detailed Backend Request Lifecycle & Security Pipeline
8-Stage Request Execution Pipeline · Edge Middleware · Identity Hydration · Granular RBAC · Schema Validation · Atomic Persistence

g.text: • Methods: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH
• No client holds MongoDB credentials, S3 secrets, or ZeptoMail keys.
• All database queries must be mediated by the backend server.
HTTPS request reaches Next.js Edge routing engine
Forwarded directly into Edge Next.js Middleware
• Evaluates request path against protected matchers:
• Reads HttpOnly session cookie from headers
• Blocks unauthenticated visits before executing server code.
• Preserves deep-link redirect target in query parameters.
Valid cookie present; request proceeds to API route handler
Transfers execution context into serverAuth guard
• Extracts raw session token from cookies()
• Performs token lookup in MongoDB Session collection
• Validates expiresAt > new Date() (7-day sliding session)
Hydrates CompanyMember, verifies active membership & company
• Token expired, missing from DB, or forged.
• User status deactivated or suspended by platform administrators.
Identity resolved; AuthenticatedRecruiter / User DTO attached
Context passes directly to RBAC authorization gate
RECRUITER: Job posting, candidate review, pipeline move
Recruiter can NEVER query or mutate jobs of another company
Candidates can only access their own profile and resumes
EARLY EXIT: PERMISSION OR TENANT VIOLATION
HTTP 403 Forbidden { success: false, error: 'Access Denied' }
• Role lacks required capability for this endpoint.
• Cross-company or unauthorized resource access attempt.
Authorization confirmed; request proceeds to input validation
• Parses request body against strict Zod definitions:
Blocks file extension spoofing attacks (e.g. .exe as .pdf)
HTTP 400 Bad Request { success: false, errors: [...] }
• Missing required fields, invalid email format, or type mismatch.
• Magic-byte signature failed or file exceeded size limit.
Type-safe validated payload passed to Domain Service
Guarantees clean, sanitized data reaches business logic
Verifies candidate owns resume; blocks duplicate application
Injects companyId, sets publishedAt, verifies company status
Elevates existing User or provisions new account + token
• Creates Immutable Resume Snapshot for recruiter review
• Automatic cleanup of freshly uploaded orphaned files on error
• Schedules non-blocking notification tasks in parallel
HTTP 400 Bad Request / 404 Not Found { error: message }
• Candidate already applied; job closed/expired; resume unowned.
• Automatically deletes newly uploaded temporary resume file.
Business invariants satisfied; data passed to Prisma Client
Executes atomic persistence operation in MongoDB
• Connection pooling via singleton Prisma instance
• Compound Unique Constraints enforce race safety:
• Indexed keys for query speed: status, email, publishedAt
• Cascade delete rules enforced on profile and company relations
HTTP 500 Internal Server Error { error: 'Persistence Error' }
• Unique constraint collision (code P2002) or connection timeout.
• Domain service catches error, rolls back local file, and logs error.
Database commit successful; returned document hydrated
Passes to async events and HTTP response dispatch
Mentor application approval & password setup link
• Email delivery record logged to EmailDelivery collection
• AuditLog event committed for administrative tracking
• Format: Clean JSON Data Transfer Object (DTO)
• Status Codes: HTTP 200 OK / HTTP 201 Created
• React UI immediately updates optimistic or revalidated state.
• Candidate dashboard shows updated application status.
• Recruiter hiring board updates applicant counts in real time.
Connection safely closed with zero memory leaks
All state transitions committed atomically to MongoDB
Every gate fails fast with structured JSON · No unhandled rejections · Orphaned files cleaned up on database write failure
